name: Genuine Edge Probe — Consumer Leaf
description: Minimal deterministic consumer leaf for the first genuine capability->capability composition. Declares input_shapes ['genuine_chain_signal'] so it only runs once a producer has populated that shape into the pool — making the orchestrator->consumer edge a TRUE shape-flow edge, not a coincidental sibling. Emits 'genuine_chain_result'. Idiomatic: native 'bash' resolver + engine outputShapes stamping. Pairs with genuine-edge-probe-producer and genuine-edge-probe-orchestrator.

tasks.description: Consume the producer's genuine_chain_signal impulse (resolved into this child's seed pool by the orchestrator's compose task) and emit a result. inputShapes declares the dependency so the engine's missing-input-shapes gap detector flags a real shape gap if the producer did not run first.

metadata.author: genuine-edge-bootstrap
metadata.purpose: First genuine non-hub composition edge. See genuine-edge-probe-orchestrator.
